name: Warm intro
description: Look at their profile, connect with a short personal note, then ask one easy question once they accept.
best_for: Cold outreach to a well-chosen list

steps.template: Hi {{first_name|there}}, came across your profile and liked what you're doing at {{company|your company}}. Would be great to connect.
Thanks for connecting, {{first_name|there}}! What are you focused on at {{company|your team}} this quarter?

name: Post commenter follow-up
description: For people who engaged with a post in your topic. Reference the shared interest, then start a conversation.
best_for: Leads from a post's comments or likes

steps.template: Hi {{first_name|there}}, saw your comment on a post I follow — good point. Let's connect.
Good to be connected, {{first_name|there}}. Curious what made that topic important to you?

name: Event or hashtag audience
description: For people from the same event, group or hashtag. Lead with the community you share.

steps.template: Hi {{first_name|there}}, we're both part of the {{custom.topic|same}} community — thought I'd say hello.
Thanks for connecting! What got you into {{custom.topic|this space}}?

name: Gentle 3-touch follow-up
description: Connect without a note, open with a light message, then follow up twice, only if they have not replied.
best_for: Prospects who go quiet after connecting

steps.template: Hi {{first_name|there}}, thanks for connecting. What does your week look like at {{company|your company}}?
{{first_name|Hi}}, just floating this back up in case it got buried. Is this something worth a quick chat?
Last note from me, {{first_name|there}}. If the timing is off, no problem at all — I'll leave it here.

name: Feedback request
description: Ask for a small piece of expertise instead of pitching. Tends to feel less like sales.
best_for: Researching a market or testing an idea

steps.template: Hi {{first_name|there}}, I'm researching how {{title|professionals}} approach outreach and would value connecting.
Thanks for connecting. Would you share one thing that works well for you? Happy to return the favour.

name: Quiet connect
description: Wait a day after viewing, connect with no note, and only message people who accept.
best_for: Warming up a new account with the lowest-friction request

steps.template: Hi {{first_name|there}}, thanks for connecting. {{company|Your company}} caught my eye — any priorities this quarter?
